title: Build Your Own Tools
brief:
The path is a single pattern — two steps right, one step down — repeated three times in a row. Instead of writing those nine moves out, give the pattern a name and call it three times.

Defining a function with def name(): lets you reuse a block of code. The real benefit appears when you call the same function more than once.
solution:
def step():
    move_right()
    move_right()
    move_down()

step()
step()
step()
open_chest()
